extension.summary: Browse and play Turkish historical series with official broadcaster fallback
extension.description: Kodi add-on for browsing and playing selected Turkish historical series (Mehmed: Fetihler Sultani, Kurulus Orhan, Salahuddin Ayyubi) using KayiFamily sources with verified official TRT1/ATV YouTube fallback. Full episode catalog, per-episode source selection, optional YouTube add-on for fallback playback. No accounts required by this add-on itself.
